components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Pill link in the sticky header.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #5b6478); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--line, #dfe2e8); color: var(--fg, #13213c); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c8102e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Blog filter by 관점 or keyword; active state inverts to navy.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e8); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--muted, #5b6478); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fg, #13213c); color: var(--bg, #ffffff); border-color: var(--fg, #13213c); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c8102e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #5b6478); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e8); border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; }

components.css: .ds-rail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 20px; border-left: 2px solid var(--line, #dfe2e8); } .ds-rail li { position: relative; padding: 0 0 24px 16px; } .ds-rail li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -27px; top: 8px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg, #ffffff); border: 2px solid var(--accent, #c8102e); } .ds-when { font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent, #c8102e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rail h3 { margin: 2px 0 4px; font-size: 19px; color: var(--fg, #13213c); } .ds-rail p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #5b6478); }

narrative.overview: A lab notebook the owner rereads: dates, conditions, numbers and limits written plainly, with cross-sections and 3D renders of the actual work as the pictures worth looking at. The palette borrows England's colours (white kit, navy, St George red) as the owner's own mark; nothing else from football or Oasis appears on the page. The page is quiet so the content can be dense. One column, generous line height, tables kept as tables. Colour is rare: navy carries the text, red marks time and the logo.
keyCharacteristics: Single 760px reading column, flat surfaces, hairline dividers.
Navy ink on pure white. Light only; there is no dark mode.
St George red reserved for dates, the timeline nodes, the logo and focus. Text selection is a light-blue block (--select).

rules.name: The Matchday Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears on at most a few small elements per screen: dates, nodes, the mark, links. If a screen looks red, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Seven Steps Rule
rules.body: Every font size is one of 96 / 32 / 22 / 19 / 16.5 / 14 / 13 px. A new size needs a reason written here first.

dos: Do keep red for dates, nodes, the logo, links and focus.
Do keep numbers in tables with units, as written in the source notes.
Do let cross-sections, plots and renders from the actual work be the images.
donts: Don't use England or FA crests, three-lions motifs, kit logos, Oasis band or album artwork, or song lyrics beyond "because, maybe".
Don't add shadows or cards; the system is flat.
Don't use a coloured border thicker than 1px on the side of a block.
